inputs.text: [frantic, overwhelmed, desperate, pleading to camera] There's GOT to be a better way!
[serene, blissed out, relaxed] I closed our biggest deal... from this hammock.

voice.name: Erby - Nerdy Regular Dude
voice.about: A youthful, high-pitched American male voice with an authentic, everyday cadence. It features natural pacing, lifelike breathing, and a highly conversational, laid-back tone. Very much a normal kind of guy!
